title: Parity Program Phase 0 Foundation
acceptance_criteria: Unified thin VyOSDriver abstraction exists and preserves existing API contracts.
Safe Apply is centralized and used by write paths touching risky domains.
Safe Apply performs snapshot + apply + probe + rollback on probe failure.
Docs crawl inventory is generated from https://docs.vyos.io/en/latest/configuration/.
Coverage matrix files are present and ready for sequential parity slicing.
Baseline backend tests for safe apply and driver behavior pass.
assumptions: VyOS HTTPS API in current project surface does not expose native commit-confirm transactions.
Emulated commit-confirm via snapshot/apply/probe/rollback is acceptable for WAN safety enforcement.
Coverage status is heuristic and requires domain-level verification as slices are implemented.

tasks.notes: Documented current VyOS integration architecture and write paths.
Implemented Safe Apply and centralized write path in VyOSService.apply_operations().
Added thin VyOSDriver abstraction and session-scoped driver accessor.
Routed direct configure writes through service.apply_operations() to enforce safety policy.
Generated full documentation coverage inventory from VyOS config guide crawl.
Added safe-apply/driver tests and updated existing doubles for new write wrapper path.
Execute domain implementation slices in documentation order toward MVP parity.
